name: DBGorilla Free
watch_out: The initial 30-day Pro trial automatically reverts to ongoing Free (1 single-host cluster, 50 monthly Gorilla Credits) unless upgraded. Free monthly credits reset and do not roll over. Credit-pack auto-reload is ON by default in provider pricing documentation; disable auto-reload explicitly to pause credit-consuming actions at zero balance and avoid unexpected purchased credits. A local read-only collector sends telemetry to the managed cloud; fully on-prem deployment is Enterprise, not Free.
